answer_1.quote: Our proposed approach introduces three key LLM roles to achieve automated chart generation and refinement: 1) Chart Code Generator generates chart code, 2) Chart Replier has the LLM answer questions about the generated chart in relation to the user's objectives, and 3) Chart Quality Evaluator assesses whether the chart is suitable based on the table, user intent, and responses.
answer_1.outputs: charts and chart-related textual responses such as answers to questions and code

answer_2.quote: such as ROUGE-L and BERTScore, which assess the performance of multimodal Language Models in generating descriptions for charts.

answer_3.quote: The role of the CQE is to assess the quality of answers provided by the CR regarding the generated chart. It evaluates how effectively the chart conveys information and identifies any missing details.
methods: evaluation based on table, query, and response from CR

answer_4.quote: To evaluate the quality of generated charts across iterative steps, we conducted a human evaluation in which five annotators rated charts generated from 150 data samples.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to rate each chart on a scale from 1 (least suitable) to 5 (most suitable) based on how well the chart matched the intended query and conveyed the relevant information.
